theorems.name: Submission.continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n])
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
